title: Queue Steward Dashboard - Real Data
description: Agent queue monitoring dashboard with real telemetry data

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'queueLength')) AS queue_depth FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%agent_queue%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'readyCount')) AS ready_count, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'pendingCount')) AS pending_count FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%agent_queue%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT any(JSONExtractBool(body, 'killSwitch')) AS kill_switch_active FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%agent_queue%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(body, 'agentName') AS agent_name, JSONExtractInt(body, 'jobsProcessed') AS jobs_processed FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%agent_queue%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
